channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: inlaut — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fully local push-to-talk dictation for German and English, running a Parakeet model on-device and typing at the cursor.

item.title: MemStats — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar memory monitor that splits RAM usage by user account, groups helper processes into apps, and shows memory pressure and swap.

item.title: FreeDisplay — via awesome-mac
item.description: Control external display brightness, HiDPI modes, resolution, and arrangement from the menu bar.

item.title: FreeAudio — via awesome-mac
item.description: Per-app volume and mute, output device switching, and volume control for HDMI/DisplayPort monitors.

item.title: FinderRight — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Finder extension that adds new file, open in terminal, copy path, and cut & paste to the right-click menu.

item.title: Device Hub Pro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Mirror, control and test Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side.

item.title: Caplo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Screen recorder and editor with automatic camera moves, cursor effects, canvas, and captions.

item.title: Boost — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free memory without closing apps, freeze apps and restore them exactly as they were, and find disk space that's genuinely safe to reclaim.

item.title: QDuo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Popup at the cursor that runs your own actions on selected text in any app: AI prompts, search, text transforms, Shortcuts, and shell scripts.

item.title: Sesame — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app that indexes the dashboards, reports, sites, PRs, and files Claude Code and Codex delivered, and reopens them when you type or say a few words.

item.title: Redlamp — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native, open-source raw photo editor that keeps Lightroom Classic's Develop workflow.

item.title: Quail — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local model server for GGUF and MLX models on Apple silicon, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs for tools like Claude Code and Codex.

item.title: Mooziac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight native macOS menu bar player for YouTube Music & local audio.

item.title: Farol — via awesome-mac
item.description: Terminal built on libghostty that shows which coding agent is working, waiting or done.

item.title: IPTVMac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U with instant search, mpv playback, Picture in Picture and downloads.

item.title: mu — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source coding agent with a CLI and a desktop app, in which a small judge model makes routine calls such as what enters the context and whether a flagged command was asked for.

item.title: Sonar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native music player with synchronized lyrics and menu bar and notch playback controls.

item.title: ThinkWatch Lite — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local gateway for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding clients that switches upstreams without client changes, records the cost of each request, and redacts API keys before requests leave.

item.title: MAC-LIMPO — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar cleaner for developer caches (Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules) with a 2D/3D disk usage treemap.

item.title: WhisperDrop 2 — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source local transcription for audio, video, YouTube, and meetings, with dictation into any app.

item.title: Rapid Reader — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source RSVP speed reader for EPUB, PDF, and web articles with a full-text view.

item.title: OpenNaga — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Razer Synapse alternative for the Naga V2 HyperSpeed that remaps the side buttons and sets DPI and polling rate.

item.title: DataNexa — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop database MCP gateway that aggregates multiple databases into a single access point with read-only enforcement and auditing for AI agents.

item.title: OpenSpatial — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source spatial audio for any headphones, playing every app as 7.1 surround with head tracking.

item.title: MacDirStat — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source disk space analyzer that shows what's taking up space as an interactive treemap, inspired by WinDirStat.

item.title: Liftoff — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Launchpad replacement with live window previews, window-title search, and one-click folder organizing.

item.title: Frpc-Desktop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop client for FRP reverse proxy and intranet penetration with a visual interface.

item.title: Classic Game Box — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source retro-console emulator frontend built on libretro cores.

item.title: Runner — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source workspace where CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, and pi work one task together as a crew, each in its own real terminal.

item.title: DockLens — via awesome-mac
item.description: Hover a Dock icon to see live thumbnails of all that app's windows, then switch, close or minimize them.

item.title: Digisensus Recorder — via awesome-mac
item.description: Call recorder and bot-free AI meeting note taker for Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime, WhatsApp and phone calls.

item.title: TBD — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source YouTube video and audio downloader built on yt-dlp, which a phone on the same Wi-Fi can also drive.

item.title: Screen Loupe — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source live magnifier that shows any part of the screen zoomed, pixel-true, in a separate window.

item.title: Lotti — via awesome-mac
item.description: Private logbook for tasks, time tracking, journaling and habits, with end-to-end encrypted sync and optional AI agents.

item.title: Brink — via awesome-mac
item.description: A notch on your screen edge that keeps your Notion pages and tasks one hover away.

item.title: Amber Notes — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source notes app that ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants can search and edit over MCP, with each AI edit highlighted and undoable.

item.title: Yalqen — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source, Chromium-based developer browser with vertical tabs and a keyboard-first command bar.

item.title: MacFanPro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fan control for Apple Silicon Macs with a menu bar app, temperature-based profiles and a CLI.

item.title: Karabiner-Elements — via awesome-mac
item.description: Remap keys and customize keyboard behavior on macOS.

item.title: HeyMate — via awesome-mac
item.description: AI assistant in the MacBook notch that answers questions about your screen out loud and runs Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode agents after you approve their plan, with media, file shelf, and calendar widgets.

item.title: Google AI Edge Eloquent — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free on-device AI dictation and voice editing from Google that works in any app, currently English only.

item.title: Belay — via awesome-mac
item.description: Keeps your Mac awake only while a local AI coding agent is working, and lets it sleep the moment the work stops.

item.title: SquirrelDisk — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source disk usage analyzer with sunburst and treemap views for disks and cloud storage.

item.title: DiskWise — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source SwiftUI disk cleaner whose only deletion path is the Trash, with per-session undo and a knowledge base that explains each cache entry.

item.title: Translate Like Me — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar translator that replaces the selected text in any app, in your own writing style, via Claude, ChatGPT or Grok.

item.title: ILoveNotch — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turns the MacBook notch into a tray for media, files, calendar, reminders, notes, and timers.

item.title: Dusty — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar disk cleaner that deletes only from a fixed allowlist, shows every path before removing it, and can undo a clean.

item.title: Lunavect — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app and desktop widgets showing which Claude Code or Codex session is working, waiting for input, or done, with usage limits and activity.

item.title: AirStats — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight menu bar system monitor for CPU, GPU, memory, network, disk, battery, and temperature, with a desktop widget.

item.title: teebe — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native manager for Git worktrees, with live file change badges and inline diffs.
